clue.text: Able to go through without a hint of resistance

indicators.note: without signals that the letter named next is dropped from the word before

parts.note: to cleave is to split or cut right through something

indicators.note: a hint of a word is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone manages to pass through a barrier without meeting even a trace of opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' drops the A from CLEAVE, leaving CLEVE; the R from 'resistance' then finishes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an able person is bright and skilful, quick-witted.

clue.text: Extend help in return

parts.note: come can mean extend or reach, as in 'the hem comes down to the knee'
to back someone is to help or support them

explanation.surface: An offer of assistance given in exchange for a favour.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a comeback is a return to former success or a quick retort.

clue.text: Meet in French bar

parts.note: en is the French word for in
a counter is the bar in a pub or shop

explanation.surface: An invitation to get together in a Parisian bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to encounter someone is to meet them, often by chance.

clue.text: Still constant

definitions.meaning: still as an adverb of emphasis, as in 'still better'
constant as in steady and unvarying

explanation.surface: Something remains unchanged and steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an intensifier meaning yet more, and level or steady without variation.

clue.text: Discontinue supporting raffle

parts.note: if you are with someone you back or support them
a draw is a lottery or raffle

explanation.surface: A charity decides to stop backing its annual prize draw.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to discontinue an offer, a product or support is to pull it back or cancel it.

clue.text: International agreement in support of politician having freedom from punishment

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece in support of another sits beneath it

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament
unity is harmony or agreement

explanation.surface: A global pact backing an MP who has been granted immunity.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact sense: impunity is exemption from penalty or harm for what you have done.

clue.text: Timeless painting seen in set acquired with much effort

indicators.note: seen in puts the trimmed word inside the other

parts.note: set means hardened, as concrete or jelly sets

indicators.note: timeless means the word loses its T, the abbreviation for time

parts.note: painting is a form of art

explanation.surface: An ageless painting hangs in a stage set that took a lot of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Timeless' removes the time abbreviation from the art word; 'set' is the participle, as concrete sets hard, not a stage set.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: hard-earned money or praise was obtained through great toil.

clue.text: Conversation cut short by religious leader

indicators.note: cut short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: rabbit is British slang for chatter, from rhyming slang 'rabbit and pork' for talk

explanation.surface: A cleric abruptly ends a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rabbi is a Jewish teacher and leader of a congregation.

clue.text: Working at first on heart shaped flower arrangement

indicators.note: at first means the opening letter of the word
shaped means the letters are moulded into a new form

explanation.surface: A florist begins on a heart-shaped display of blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a wreath is a ring of flowers or leaves, often laid at funerals.

clue.text: Pull out of the Spanish climbing party right away

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the word reads upwards

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: away means the letter is removed

parts.note: a rave is a lively party

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a Spanish party at once, heading uphill.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to pull out of something is to withdraw or depart from it.

clue.text: Knife one of a pair carried by revolutionary? Just the opposite

indicators.note: carried by would put the pair word inside the revolutionary's name, holding it
just the opposite reverses the containment, so the revolutionary goes inside instead

parts.note: a mate is one of a matching pair, as with socks or gloves
Che Guevara, the Argentine-born revolutionary

explanation.surface: A guerrilla fighter has a knife that is half of a matched set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carried by' alone would put the pair word inside the revolutionary; 'Just the opposite' tells you to swap which piece holds which.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a machete is a broad, heavy knife used for cutting vegetation.

clue.text: Starts to become less enraged after soldier's story

indicators.note: after puts the initials that follow behind the soldier in the answer

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier

indicators.note: starts to the next words means their opening letters

explanation.surface: A soldier's tale of how he finally began to calm down.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a parable is a short moral story, such as those told in the Gospels.

clue.text: Close to cancelling amateur fight

indicators.note: cancelling means a letter is struck out of the word for close to

parts.note: about can mean near, close to, as in 'about here'

explanation.surface: An amateur boxing match is on the verge of being called off.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a bout is a single contest in boxing or wrestling, a fight.

clue.text: Preacher performing live on stage lacks authority essentially

indicators.note: performing suggests the letters being put through their paces in a new arrangement
lacks says a letter is missing from the rearranged pool
essentially points to the essence or centre of the word, its middle letter

explanation.surface: A performer on stage turns out to have no real authority over the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of LIVE ON STAGE, less the O at the centre of 'authority', are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an evangelist travels to spread the Christian gospel by preaching.

clue.text: Belief in nature

definitions.meaning: a creed or faith, as in 'of the Catholic ...'
a kind or sort, as in 'people of that ...'

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a religious faith or conviction, and a type or kind of thing.

clue.text: Animal caught earlier by old farm worker

indicators.note: earlier puts the abbreviation in front of the animal

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
an otter is a river animal

explanation.surface: A farmhand of old once trapped a creature before anyone else did.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic term: a cotter was a peasant farm labourer given a cottage in return for work.

clue.text: Son heard about Omani leader celebrated in legends

indicators.note: about means going around the leader's letter

parts.note: a case heard in court is tried

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A son learns what is said about the ruler of Oman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heard' looks like a homophone signal, but it means tried, as in a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a storied place or person features in many tales, famous in story.

clue.text: Former secretary introduced to sect by head of English is free from blame

indicators.note: by means next to, so the letter follows

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: introduced to means put inside

parts.note: a cult is a sect
PA is a personal assistant, a secretary

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An ex-secretary who joined a cult is cleared by an English leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to exculpate someone is to clear them of guilt.

clue.text: Cowardly to withdraw statement implicating soldiers

indicators.note: implicating means involving, taking the soldiers in

parts.note: to recant is to take back what you said
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A craven witness retracts testimony that incriminated troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Literary synonym: a recreant is a coward or traitor, and as an adjective it means craven.

clue.text: Cursed person from Botswana: the Magician!

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A sorcerer from southern Africa is a figure of damnation.
explanation.definitionFit: Sense: an anathema is something or someone detested, formally cursed by a church.

clue.text: Turn out well for Miranda's dad? Not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely means the name loses its final letter

parts.note: in Shakespeare's The Tempest, Miranda is the daughter of the magician Prospero

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether Miranda's father might succeed, a question about The Tempest.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to prosper is to thrive or do well.

clue.text: It serves as a warning for meat eating earl

indicators.note: eating means the meat swallows the abbreviation, holding it inside

parts.note: bacon is cured pork meat

explanation.surface: A nobleman eats bacon, which is a cautionary sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Function: a signal fire on a hill or a lighthouse lamp alerts people to danger.

clue.text: Letter about returning to Jenny oddly lacking insight

indicators.note: returning means the pair are read backwards

parts.note: mu is a Greek letter
ca is short for circa, about

indicators.note: oddly lacking means the odd-numbered letters go, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A letter returned to Jenny shows she lacks perceptiveness.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: acumen is sharpness of judgment, keen insight.

clue.text: At present concerned with a situation doomed to failure

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase for a hopeless situation; the answer is the adjective used for one

parts.note: now means at present
in can mean involved or concerned with, as in 'in on the plan'

explanation.surface: Someone currently stuck in a hopeless predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a no-win situation is one where every outcome is bad.

clue.text: Fellow countryman Sepp's back living in converted attic room

indicators.note: living in places the letter inside the rearranged room
a converted room is remade, so these letters are rearranged
the back of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A Swiss named Sepp lives in a loft conversion with someone from home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' rearranges ATTIC ROOM to COMATRIOT, and the P ending 'Sepp's' goes into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a compatriot comes from the same country as you.

clue.text: Massachusetts mother and brothel keeper

parts.note: MA is the postal abbreviation for Massachusetts
a dam is the mother of an animal

explanation.surface: A woman from Massachusetts is both a parent and the owner of a bawdy house.
explanation.definitionFit: Sense: a madam is a woman who runs a brothel.

clue.text: Dead monotonous

definitions.meaning: dead as in a battery or a drink that has lost its fizz
monotonous as in a dull voice lacking variety

explanation.surface: A deadly dull, lifeless description.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a battery or beer with no life left, and a voice or delivery without variation.

clue.text: Keep secret papers in a couple of heaps

indicators.note: in places the papers inside the letters taken from heaps
a couple of means two letters, here the first two

parts.note: ID means identity papers

explanation.surface: Classified documents are buried in two piles.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to hide something is to conceal it.

clue.text: Crazy time touring Italy's principal island

parts.note: mad means crazy

indicators.note: touring means going around the letter

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: the principal letter of a word is its first

explanation.surface: A wild holiday tour of Italy taking in its chief island.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Madeira is a Portuguese island in the Atlantic.

clue.text: Pretend to be with it around left-leaning Australian guy on ecstasy

indicators.note: around means the first word goes round the reversed pair

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: left-leaning in a word read across means leaning back to the left, written backwards

parts.note: Tim stands in for any man's name, a guy
E is the street abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A trendy left-wing Aussie man, high on drugs, is putting on an act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left-leaning' looks political but in an across clue means written right to left, reversing MITA from the Australian guy; 'with it' is a link plus the letters IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to imitate someone is to mimic or impersonate them.

clue.text: Propose for election in Maine — not surprisingly

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Someone in the state of Maine is put forward for office, which is no surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to nominate a candidate is to put them forward for a post.

clue.text: Spirit shown by City

definitions.meaning: a gin made in the Netherlands, also called jenever or Hollands
a Swiss city on Lake Leman

explanation.surface: A drink displayed by a town, perhaps a local brand.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the old name for Dutch gin, and the Swiss city.
